name: Seraphina
source: Seraphina is the older sister of the Witch Queen [url=/c163004]Arianne[/url]. She works behind the scenes to ensure that everyone is properly cared for. She is a powerful and level-headed witch, however, has always lived in the shadow of her sister. Her magical abilities play a role in helping her stay in good shape and it's rumored that she east at least three full-sized chocolate cakes every day.
